# Bishwaraj Pokharel

Bishwaraj Pokharel () is a Nepalese politician and former additional inspector general (AIG) of Nepal Police serving as a member of parliament from the  Rastriya Swatantra Party. He is the member of the 3rd Federal Parliament of Nepal elected from Okhaldhunga 1 constituency in 2026 Nepalese General Election securing 13,953  votes and defeating Kumar Luitel of the Nepali Congress with a narrow margin of five votes.
